|lore=Male Gand. Practitioner of ancient religious findsman vocation. Bounty hunter and scout. Gains surprisingly accurate information through mystical visions during meditation.
|game_text=Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. ''Mist Hunter'' is maneuver +1. Your Black Sun agents at same and related sites may not have their forfeit reduced. Once per game, may deploy non-[[Permanent Weapon]] 4-LOM here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to attrition < 3.
